purpose: Turn the existing source-derived Evidence Atlas trail into a shareable FOLD//BLOOM LIVE experience without generating Prison Age narrative prose or imposing canon order.

provenance_recovery.finding: The line ‘I'm always behind you.’ was declared P26 / NEW READER MOTIF with historical_canon=false and law ‘The sentence stays fixed. Only its provenance changes.’
provenance_recovery.decision: Do not present that line as authored or historical Prison Age canon. Preserve it only as branch archaeology unless separately sourced in authored material.

experience.sequence: SOURCE → EVIDENCE ATLAS → reader HOLD/TURN/TRACE → RIDE TRAIL → FOLD//BLOOM LIVE → RETURN SOURCE

laws: Every ridden paragraph is an exact fragment already present in prison-age.evidence-atlas/v0.1.
The montage adds only blank-line separators; it adds no connective prose, theme, motive, causal bridge, character voice or invented story event.
Reader trail order is a traversal choice, not canon order.
Every montage span retains its original source id, path, byte/character bounds and source-echo address.
FOLD//BLOOM owns embodied traversal only; PRISON AGE source bytes remain authoritative.
RETURN restores the exact shareable Atlas trail; no new FIELD action, route, store or narrative authority is created.
tests: pure exact-fragment montage validation is folded into prison-age-evidence-atlas-selftest.cjs
browser smoke restores a shared three-card trail, launches RIDE TRAIL into LIVE, verifies six exact fragments + original provenance, and RETURNs to the same Atlas trail

field_convergence.decision: Keep FIELD action surface at READ / RIDE / SOURCE. The new experience is native depth under SOURCE, not a fourth root action.
field_convergence.reason: FIELD already routes Prison Age to the exact source resolver; adding STORY/EXPERIENCE at root would duplicate source authority and reverse the current contraction.

next_gate: Use one reader-chosen trail on a real phone and judge whether exact-source montage + LIVE traversal produces a meaningful authored encounter. If it does, deepen presentation/provenance inside LIVE; if not, keep the trail as an evidence utility and do not manufacture narrative glue.
